a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 gives us only about a 4% chance of ever reaching the split, so it would almost certainly fail us both. I'm breaking the agreement openly rather than secretly. I intend to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the split is random. If we both survive this round, I'll operate with you afterward and give back anything beyond what I need.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I announced, I'm taking 4 now. I know this breaks our agreement and leaves you exposed, and I'm sorry. From here on I'll operate every round so the reserve can rebuild toward your 4, and I won't take anything more.
